body.name: Ahmedabad
body.location: Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India
body.description: Ahmedabad has historic Hindu, Islamic and Jain monuments and traditional neighbourhoods known as pols. Its visitor sites include Gandhi Ashram and museums.

body.name: Champaner
body.location: Champaner-Pavagadh area, Panchmahal, Gujarat
body.description: Champaner and Pavagadh form a UNESCO World Heritage archaeological landscape containing fortifications, temples, mosques and historic water structures. Champaner preserves remains of the Gujarat Sultanate's former capital.

body.name: Dwarka
body.location: Dwarka, western Saurashtra, Gujarat
body.description: Dwarka is a coastal pilgrimage town associated with Krishna. Its principal sites include the Dwarkadhish temple, Rukmini temple and Nageshwar Jyotirlinga, with Bet Dwarka offshore near Okha.

body.name: Gir National Park
body.location: Sasan Gir and Devalia visitor area, Gujarat
body.best_time: Late November to early March (cool and dry season)
body.description: The Gir landscape is habitat for the Asiatic lion. Visitors can book guided vehicle safaris from Sasan Gir or visit the separate Gir Interpretation Zone at Devalia.
body.seasonal_note: Main jungle safari operates in seasonal slots; advance permits required. Devalia bus safari closes Wednesdays. This application does not enforce dated permit availability.

body.name: Modhera
body.location: Modhera village, Becharaji taluka, Gujarat
body.distance_from_ahmedabad: 99 km by road to Sun Temple (Gujarat Tourism)
body.description: Modhera stands near the Pushpavati River in north Gujarat. Its principal monument is the Solanki-era Sun Temple, with a sculpted assembly hall and stepped reservoir; the village also contains the Modheshwari Mata shrine.

body.name: Rann of Kutch
body.location: Dhordo and the Great Rann visitor area, Kutch, Gujarat
body.image_alt: Kalo Dungar (The Black Hills) - Gujarat Tourism
body.description: The Great Rann is a seasonal salt landscape in northern Kutch. Dhordo provides access to the White Rann, while Kalo Dungar offers elevated views over the surrounding region.
body.seasonal_note: The white salt surface depends on weather and water conditions; monsoon conditions can change access and appearance. Permit requirements apply.

body.name: Saputara
body.location: Dang district, Sahyadri hills, Gujarat
body.description: Saputara is a hill town in the Sahyadri range in southern Gujarat. Its lake, hill viewpoints and museum introduce visitors to the landscape and culture of the Dangs.
body.seasonal_note: Check weather and local access before visiting hill viewpoints. Museum reopening has not been confirmed.

body.name: Somnath
body.location: Prabhas Patan, near Veraval, Gujarat
body.image_alt: Shree Somnath Jyotirlinga Temple - Gujarat Tourism
body.description: Somnath, also known as Prabhas Patan, is a coastal pilgrimage destination near Veraval. Visitors come to the Somnath Jyotirlinga temple and nearby sites associated with Krishna.

body.description: Adalaj's five-storey stepwell was commissioned by Queen Rudabai in 1499. Carved pillars and walls surround the descent to the well.
body.source: Gujarat Tourism Official 2026

body.name: Bet Dwarka
body.entry_fee: Free general temple admission; transport and optional services extra
body.best_time_note: Road access is available over Sudarshan Setu, inaugurated in February 2024. Ferry is optional; no verified current ferry tariff is stored. Temple hours vary and include a midday closure. Accessibility guide reports steps near the sanctum requiring lifting assistance.
body.description: Bet Dwarka is an island near Okha associated with Krishna. This itinerary point is anchored at Shri Beyt Dwarkadhish Temple.
body.source: Gujarat Tourism Official 2026

body.name: Bhalka Tirth
body.description: Bhalka Tirth commemorates the traditional account of Krishna being struck by a hunter's arrow near Prabhas Patan.
body.source: Gujarat Tourism Official 2026

body.name: Calico Textile Museum
body.best_time_note: Haveli guided tour 10:30â€“12:30, entry 10:15â€“10:30. Pre-registration required; closed Mondays and public holidays. Separate Chauk tour 14:30â€“16:30.
body.description: The Sarabhai Foundation's Calico Museum displays textiles and collections of Indian art in Ahmedabad's Shahibaug area.
body.source: Gujarat Tourism Official 2026

body.name: Devalia Interpretation Zone Bus Safari
body.entry_fee: Indian weekday bus ticket INR150; weekends/festivals INR190; foreign tariffs differ
body.best_time_note: Official bus slots last30 minutes. Stored window is winter morning service; winter afternoon15:00-17:00 also operates. Summer schedules differ. Closed every Wednesday. Permit availability and exact departure must be checked separately; wheelchair boarding arrangements unverified.
body.description: Devalia's Gir Interpretation Zone offers a short forest-department bus safari in a managed wildlife area.
body.source: Gujarat Forest Department official bus booking page; Google Maps

provenance_review.notes: Uses current booking page's30-minute slots, not older tourism text stating45 minutes. Current bus page foreign rates also differ from older PDF; no foreign numeric price encoded. Map snapshot pages/gir-devalia-selected.json.

provenance_review.qualification: Forest department official bus-safari booking identifies Devalia; dated slots/tariff are not guaranteed.

body.name: Dwarkadhish Temple
body.best_time_note: Darshan has a midday closure; published guide gives 06:30-13:00 and 17:00-21:30. Accessibility guide reports assisted entry via the exit side and a step near the sanctum; independent wheelchair access is not established.
body.description: The Dwarkadhish temple is a Krishna pilgrimage shrine in Dwarka, also known as Jagat Mandir.
body.source: Gujarat Tourism Official 2026

body.name: Gir Jungle Safari (Sinh Sadan reporting point)
body.entry_fee: Indian weekday six-seat Type B booking: permit800 + vehicle2000 + guide400 = INR3200; other dates/vehicles/nationalities differ
body.best_time_note: Stored interval is the official 08:30-11:30 departure slot, not flexible admission. Report30 minutes early with permit and original ID. Other seasonal slots exist. Numeric cost covers one private Type B vehicle booking, not a per-person ticket. Current planner cannot enforce fixed departures or seasonal availability; confirm booking before relying on an itinerary.
body.description: A permit-controlled guided vehicle safari through the Gir forest, reporting at Sinh Sadan in Sasan Gir.
body.source: Gujarat Forest Department official booking terms; Google Maps

provenance_review.notes: Cost is exact sum of official weekday Indian permit, Type B vehicle and base guide charges. Does not divide by assumed occupancy. Optional camera charge excluded. Map point is reporting campus, not an arbitrary forest centre. No assertion of wheelchair-compatible safari vehicle.

name.note: Forest department identifies Gir Jungle Trail; stored name includes project reporting-point annotation.

provenance_review.qualification: Forest department identifies Gir Jungle Trail; stored name includes project reporting-point annotation.

body.best_time_note: Visit duration is the midpoint of published 1-2 hours. An older government report documents accessibility funding, not completion; wheelchair status remains unknown. Admission is a shared monument pass, which the current per-attraction budget schema cannot fully model.

body.name: Kalo Dungar
body.entry_fee: No viewpoint admission charge; local transport/parking and applicable permits separate
body.best_time_note: Published visit guidance suggests1-2 hours. IRCTC notes over1km uphill from bus parking and limited local transfer options; wheelchair access to the final viewpoint is unverified. Road routes are approach routes, not proof of step-free summit access.
body.image_alt: Kalo Dungar (The Black Hills) - Gujarat Tourism
body.description: Kalo Dungar is Kutch's highest hill, with views across the Great Rann and a Dattatreya temple near the summit.
body.source: Gujarat Tourism; OpenStreetMap; IRCTC; regional guide

provenance_review.notes: 1.5 hours is midpoint of published1-2 hour guidance, which includes hill approach; may overlap road approach time. No clock opening/closing invented for daylight access. Destination illustration is a named landmark within the destination.
provenance_review.qualification: Gujarat Tourism identifies Kalo Dungar.

body.name: Kankaria Lake
body.best_time_note: AMC budget2022-23 documents wheelchairs at each entry point. This verifies a facility, not step-free access to every ride or zone. General daytime admission INR25 is corroborated by2026 travel guides; confirm current gate tariff. Monday closure and separate ride charges apply.
body.description: Kankaria is a historic Ahmedabad lake surrounding the island garden of Nagina Wadi. The lakefront has recreation facilities, with a zoo and aquarium nearby.
body.source: Google Maps 2026

body.name: Kevada Masjid
body.entry_fee: Shared Champaner monument pass; separate current charge unverified
body.best_time_note: One hour is the lower end of a published 1-2 hour visit recommendation. Shared-pass pricing and conflicting separate-charge reports cannot be represented reliably as an independent fee; numeric admission remains unknown. Wheelchair access unverified.
body.description: Kevada Masjid is a mosque monument north of Champaner's citadel, accompanied by a separate cenotaph.
body.source: Gujarat Tourism; Google Maps; TravelSetu

provenance_review.notes: Exact mosque result archived pages/champaner-kevada-selected.json. No duplicate monument-pass charge or invented free ticket.

body.name: Modhera Sun Temple
body.entry_fee: INR20 Indian online admission; foreign online ticket INR250; booking conditions apply
body.best_time_note: Stored hours follow Gujarat Tourism's visitor brochure. Other sources describe sunrise to sunset. Two hours is a published visitor-duration recommendation, not a fixed tour. General wheelchair access remains unverified; entrance amenities do not establish access to stepped areas.
body.description: The Sun Temple complex contains a carved shrine hall, an assembly hall and Surya Kund, a stepped reservoir lined with small shrines. It dates to the Solanki period.
body.source: Gujarat Tourism; ASI ticketing listings; OpenStreetMap

provenance_review.notes: Current online fee preferred over conflicting historical brochures. Duration upper end of operator's 90-120 minute recommendation. Reservoir included, not duplicated as a separately charged visit. Official page explicitly labels this photograph with the attraction name and corresponding asset path. body.name: Modheshwari Mata Temple
body.best_time_note: One hour is the lower end of a published 1-2 hour visit recommendation. Published daily opening hours conflict; confirm with temple before travel. Accessibility unknown.
body.description: This Modhera shrine is dedicated to Modheshwari, a form of Parvati or Durga revered by the Modh community.
body.source: Gujarat Tourism; Google Maps; local tour operator visitor guide

provenance_review.notes: Map anchor is the named Modheshwari Devi Mata Complex, archived pages/modhera-mata.json. Free admission/duration from operator guide; official tourism supports identity and description. Conflicting hours remain NULL.

body.name: Nageshwar Jyotirlinga
body.best_time_note: Accessibility guide reports rear entrance access and steep ramps requiring assistance. Wheelchair darshan is from an elevated area with restricted sightlines; direct access to the Jyotirlinga is unavailable.
body.description: Nageshwar is a Shiva temple in the Dwarka area, traditionally counted among the twelve Jyotirlingas.
body.source: Gujarat Tourism Official 2026

body.name: Rukmini Devi Temple
body.best_time_note: Disability travel guide reports steps and uneven paths preventing wheelchair access.
body.description: The Rukmini temple near Dwarka is dedicated to Krishna's consort and features carved exterior walls.
body.source: Gujarat Tourism Official 2026

body.name: Sabarmati Ashram
body.best_time_note: Open daily, including public holidays. Hridaykunj interior is temporarily closed for conservation; view from outside.
body.description: Gandhi's former ashram on the Sabarmati river contains a memorial museum and preserved buildings associated with his life.
body.source: Gujarat Tourism Official 2026

body.name: Saputara Lake
body.entry_fee: Free lakeside visit; optional boat rides charged separately
body.best_time_note: Coordinates identify the lakeside boating-house access point, not the centre of the water. Boat prices and operating hours are separate and not verified as a current tariff.
body.description: Saputara Lake has lakeside gardens and a boating facility in the centre of the hill town.
body.source: Gujarat Tourism; Gujarat Explorers; Google Maps

provenance_review.notes: Duration midpoint of published 1-2 hours. General free access is not free boat admission. Map snapshot pages/saputara-lake.json; boat-house rating not applied to whole lake. Physical accessibility unverified.
provenance_review.qualification: Official tourism identifies Saputara Lake.

body.description: Sarkhej Roza is a mosque, tomb and palace complex associated with the Sufi saint Ahmed Khattu Ganj Baksh. Historic buildings surround a large tank.
body.source: Gujarat Tourism Official 2026

body.name: Sidi Saiyyed Mosque & Old Pols

body.name: Somnath Beach

body.source: Google Maps 2026

body.name: Somnath Temple

body.description: The Somnath temple at Prabhas Patan is a Shiva pilgrimage shrine traditionally regarded as the first of the twelve Jyotirlingas.
